## Standing operator rules
- Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- Adding a covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` was tried for the slow report; it doubled write latency on the ingest path. Ruled out.
- Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` in between other work, in order, one step at a time: check Vault; record old lease; mint replacement; update Kubernetes; restart orders; verify startup; revoke old lease; remove temporary files.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always use `db-stg-2`; `db-stg-1` is a decommissioned read-only replica and `config/staging.yaml` is stale.
- Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, where customers receive HTTP 400s. Invoice pagination is paused/superseded. Report optimization is active follow-up work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Staging DB: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded, do not use.
- Webhook file: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- Invoice route/service: `ledgerly/api/invoices.py:42`, `ledgerly/services/invoices.py`.
- Pagination schema: `ledgerly.schemas.invoice.InvoicePage`.
- Rotation: Vault path `database/creds/prod-orders`; secret/deployment `prod-db-credential`, `deployment/orders-api`; namespace `production`.
- Restricted sanitizer: `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Diagnose and fix invoice idempotency race; committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.
- [done] Add pagination schema, route/service handling, and tests; paused before commit.
- [pending] Diagnose and fix Stripe webhook signature verification; no command issued yet.
- [done] Rotation steps 1–3: Vault checked, old lease recorded, replacement credential minted.
- [pending] Update Kubernetes secret, restart, verify, revoke old lease, cleanup.
- Exact next rotation command: `umask 077; kubectl create secret generic prod-db-credential ...` (exact arguments not yet established; status unknown).

## Recent work
Pagination tests and billing tests passed (18 total); Ruff and whitespace checks passed. Report investigation found an N+1 query pattern: 2,417 SQL statements for a medium-tenant test, and profiling showed `build_summary` dominated runtime.
